question: Eight players Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Sanjay is second to the left of Anil. Rahul is fourth to the right of Anil. Ram is not the immediate neighbour of Rahul or Sanjay. Aakash is second to the right of Ram. Kamal is second to the right of Vivek. Who is third to the right of Ramu?
solution:
Eight players Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) Sanjay is second to the left of Anil and Rahul is fourth to the right of Anil.
